description: This file contains the PHP class 'CustomerGroup' which defines methods for managing customer groups in the OpenCart system, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving customer group data and descriptions.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: A PHP class managing customer groups, including CRUD operations and description management.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Adds a new customer group and its descriptions to the database.

methods.name: editCustomerGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing customer group and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroup
methods.description: Deletes a customer group and all associated descriptions, discounts, specials, and rewards.

methods.name: getCustomerGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific customer group by ID.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of customer groups with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a customer group.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions filtered by language ID.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a customer group in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific customer group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer groups.
